== Summary ==
Slip “Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 1229, 1624, 1513)). Version [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
